title: On this page
summary: An anchor list of the headings inside a target element with scroll-spy: the heading in view is marked as you read; works with the window or an inner scroller such as the shell body.

props.name: for
props.description: The element whose headings are listed.

props.name: offset
props.description: Distance from the top a heading must reach to count as current.

parts.name: list
parts.description: The list of heading links (built inside it)

writes.target: the headings elsewhere in the document that the for selector matches
writes.why: A heading without an id gets a slug of its text, so the link and the scroll spy have something to point at. Only ever added, never changed or removed. Kept when the element disconnects.

a11y: A nav landmark; the current link has aria-current="location"; links are real anchors, so the browser handles focus and history.
mobile: Not sticky below 1024px; links are 44px tall.
